name: ZeroSettle
long_description:
ZeroSettle is an iMessage API. Each customer gets a dedicated phone number that sends and receives real iMessages from their own code or AI agent. Plans start at $49/month.

Developers send and receive messages through a REST API and webhooks. AI agents connect through our MCP server, which works with Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor. Each number supports photos, videos, voice memos, typing indicators, inline replies, polls, group chats and FaceTime Audio calls. For teams that don’t want to write code, a built-in AI agent can answer texts for them, and conversations sync to Close, GoHighLevel, and HubSpot.

Companies use ZeroSettle for customer support, sales follow-up, appointment reminders, retention offers, Sign in with iMessage, and AI assistants that live in iMessage. iMessage needs no 10DLC registration, and each number handles up to 10,000 messages a day on Apple hardware we operate in a server facility.
one_liner: iMessage API for businesses and AI agents
